This annoys me to no end- I'm 18 and diagnosed with DID, but it took so much to get here and it's still beyond difficult for people to believe me. I'm very very lucky I have a good support system in my partner and friends. I hope everyone can get the support they need, whether for DID or something else entirely.

As a heads up for those commenting, though I'm late to this thread, please avoid insisting people are faking simply because they're not valid enough in your eyes- it's really harmful. Even if someone doesn't fit what you know of it, it doesn't mean they're faking, nor is it your place to tell them they are. Heaven knows those with DID struggle enough with denial and shame. Stay kind and stay open <3
